summary: iter361 Outreach Lesson Planning — full-stack review. Backend: original 7/7 pytest suite passes; added 5 more targeted tests for RBAC (Volunteer allowed, Member 403), theme-delete-when-in-use (400), PO with no snacks (400), and Volunteer plan creation — all 5 pass. Frontend: sidebar 'Lesson Planning' nav works, page renders with data-testid='lesson-planning-page' and all 5 tabs. Outreach events tab lists seeded 'Kids Club Outreach (sample)' + 2 test events, non-outreach 'meeting' event correctly excluded. Session-plan authoring flow works end-to-end: yearly theme picker, topic, verse, target, running-order slots, worship songs, games, snacks/kit, materials, story fields, offering, take-home all persist after save (verified by reload + deep link ?event=<id>). Raise-order button generated PO-2026-000003 with correct line items. Run sheet popup opens with topic, memory verse, slot titles, songs, snacks all present. Mark-final toggle works. Yearly theme creation with topic works and appears in list. Library tab surfaces newly-typed songs/games. Duplicate dialog opens with target selectors. Deep link /lesson-planning?event=<id> auto-opens the correct plan. Mobile 390x844: ZERO horizontal overflow on all 4 tested tabs. 'Plan this' button verified in CalendarPage source (gated by type==='outreach', navigates to deep link).
critical_code_review_comments: lesson_planning.py list_library() still reads scope['location_id'] directly (line ~131) instead of using _allowed_locations() helper — same silent-no-op class of bug that was fixed in _plan_or_404. Not blocking today because admin is unscoped, but Volunteer scoped to a campus will not filter properly. Same pattern in outreach_events() at line ~187.
duplicate_plan endpoint does not respect _allowed_locations for the TARGET event — a cross-campus admin could copy onto a campus they cannot access. _plan_or_404 covers the source only.
plan_to_purchase_order() uses count_documents()+1 as PO number seed which is O(n) on every raise; fine at low volume but consider a counter collection later.
LessonPlanningPage.jsx is a single 450-line file — approaching the 700 line guideline but still manageable; would benefit from splitting the plan editor sub-form into its own component.
